title: Zoom For Me
description: A lightweight client-side mod that adds a smooth and fluid zoom function to Minecraft. Simply hold the C key to seamlessly zoom in, and release it to smoothly transition back to your normal field of view.
body:
# How to use:
Hold the C key to zoom in with a smooth transition animation
Release the C key to seamlessly return to your normal field of view
The zoom effect is proportional to your current FOV setting
Features:

Smooth zoom animation that feels natural and responsive
Works entirely on the client side - no server-side installation required
Compatible with all game modes (singleplayer, multiplayer, realms)
Lightweight with minimal performance impact
Easy to use with a single key press
